decision.notes: Jinshu 53 names 王戎 太傅 of Crown Prince Minhuai under Hui Di. Jinshu 35 names 戎 as 王綏's father and lists 王戎 among the eight Wangs of Wei-Jin, treating 王綏 as a distinct analogue.
